chain.text: The observatory operates a 60-centimetre reflector installed in 2017. A 20-centimetre refractor is used for public outreach. Useful nights average 195 a year. 2024 had 168 useful nights because of an unusually wet autumn. Data volume is about 400 gigabytes a month. Data is archived to a university server in Marseille. The nightly transfer takes 40 minutes. The main camera was replaced in March 2025 after its cooling system failed twice. The new sensor has 30 percent lower read noise. The new sensor requires a firmware update not yet applied. The update requires taking the instrument offline for a full night. In 2023 a dome rotation motor seized during a session. The telescope tracked into the dome wall, bending a counterweight rod. The rod was replaced and a limit switch added. In February 2025 three weeks of photometry were lost. The observatory operates a 60-centimetre reflector installed in 2017.  
A 20-centimetre refractor is used for public outreach.  
Useful nights average 195 a year.  
2024 had 168 useful nights because of an unusually wet autumn.  
Data volume is about 400 gigabytes a month.  
Data is archived to a university server in Marseille.  
The nightly transfer takes 40 minutes.  
The main camera was replaced in March 2025 after its cooling system failed twice.  
The new sensor has 30 percent lower read noise.  
The new sensor requires a firmware update not yet applied.  
The update requires taking the instrument offline for a full night.  
In 2023 a dome rotation motor seized during a session.  
The telescope tracked into the dome wall, bending a counterweight rod.  
The rod was replaced and a limit switch added.  
In February 2025 three weeks of photometry were lost.
